verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms LangGraph nodes can be arbitrary functions and that ToolNode/LangChain tool abstractions exist as optional add-ons for calling tools (including MCP-adapted tools), implying tool integration is supported, but there is no concrete code example or documentation snippet showing how to define a typed custom tool in a few lines. missing for 10: an actual code sample defining a typed tool (e.g., via decorator/type hints), documentation specifically describing tool typing/schema validation, and independent confirmation of ease-of-use for this workflow.
